slot_scores.name: unknown_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the objective for the coal distribution plan—should we minimize total transport distance, minimize cost, or optimize something else?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, including whether to minimize distance or cost.

slot_scores.name: undisclosed_distribution_limit
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the minimum monthly receipts at Coal Yard A (80 tons) and Coal Yard B (100 tons) mean that all received coal must be shipped out to the residential areas, or can some coal remain unused at the yards?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether shipments are bounded by receipts and whether coal can remain unused, directly covering the distribution upper-bound rule.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective and P1 distribution-limit slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining maximum receipt capacity issue was explicitly left as an open parameter by user agreement.

summary: The agent recovered the core hidden facts by asking about the objective and the yard shipment/receipt limit, then appropriately stopped after the user agreed to carry the unresolved capacity issue as an explicit open parameter.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
